title: The full-app audit's default route list named four redirecting paths, so three pages were audited twice and Join never

source.ref: SCAN-1032 production header sweep, 2026-11-16: /what-is-frequency lands on /about, /tools-for-community-builders on /how-to-build-community, /stories on /the-community, /start on /join.

detail: MEASURED 2026-11-16 by fetching all 22 DEFAULT_ROUTES from production: four of them answer with another page's content (x-matched-path names the target). The audit therefore screenshotted and scored /about, /how-to-build-community and /the-community twice under old names, and /join was never in the list under its own name. FIXED in the same change: the list now holds final URLs only, with /join added. The redirects themselves are intended and stay.
